title_sq: Shitet Vile individuale ne Zonen e Liqenit te That !
description_sq:
Vile per shitje te Liqeni That !
Shitet Vile individuale ne Zonen e Liqenit te That !
Ndodhet te zona e Ullishtes me pamje te lire Nga liqeni dhe Tirana !
Eshte e organizuar ne 4 kate nga 123.8 m2 dhe kati mbi cati me 46 m2 plus 05 m2 Verande Panormaike.
Aktualisht eshte ne faze karabina, tull, dhe shitet ne kete faze.
Disponon certifikate pronesie.
Per me shume informacion apo vizit ne prone, na kontaktoni !
title_en: Individual villas for sale in the That Lake area!
description_en: Villa for sale at Lake That! Individual villas for sale in the That Lake area! It is located in the Ullishte area with a clear view of the lake and Tirana! It is organized in 4 floors of 123.8 m2 and the floor above the roof with 46 m2 plus 05 m2 Panoramic Veranda. It is currently in the carbine, brick stage, and is sold in this stage. It has ownership certificates. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
